div.h3:
To become a globally leading, innovation-driven
comprehensive energy service provider.
div.p:
TDG YUNET focuses on advanced energy storage technology R&D and integrated energy
services, driving the global energy transition through innovative technologies and striving to
become a globally leading innovation-driven integrated energy service provider.

div.h3:
Continuously Delivering
High-Quality Solutions to
the Global Market

div.p:
China (Haining) manufacturing center &
Spain (Zaragoza) manufacturing center

For commercial and industrial users with significant peak-valley price differentials and high load fluctuations, configuring energy storage and implementing integrated energy management can effectively reduce electricity costs. In the event of a power outage or power curtailment, the energy storage system can continuously supply power to local loads, ensuring the continuity of production and operation for commercial and industrial users.
By integrating advanced energy storage technology with intelligentmanagement systems, we provide the power system with secureefficient, and flexible energy storage and dispatch capabilities.

img.alt: Integrated PV + Storage + Charging + Generator Solutions
img.title: Integrated PV + Storage + Charging + Generator Solutions

h3.title: Integrated PV + Storage + Charging + Generator Solutions

div.h3: Integrated PV + Storage + Charging + Generator Solutions

div.p: An integrated energy system combining photovoltaic power generation, energy storage systems, diesel generators, and charging facilities enhances energy efficiency, ensures stable power supply, and reduces carbon emissions through multi-energy complementarity.

This system integrates advanced energy storage technology and intelligent management systems internally, endowing itself with flexible energy storage and dispatch capabilities. It supports multi-scenario applications: it can be used for emergency rescue tasks, while in normal conditions, it serves various purposes such as peak-valley arbitrage, capacity expansion, and renewable energy curtailment management.

div.h3: The Latest News From TDG YUNET

img.alt: Jointly Building an All-Weather Community with a Shared Future: China–Zimbabwe Green Energy Cooperation Takes a Solid Step Forward at TDG YUNET

a.p: Jointly Building an All-Weather Community with a Shared Future: China–Zimbabwe Green Energy Cooperation Takes a Solid Step Forward at TDG YUNET

On September 9, 2025, the heads of state of China and Zimbabwe announced the elevation of bilateral relations to an all-weather community with a shared future. Under this friendly context, on November 14, a delegation from Zimbabwe’s FRONTERAS company visited TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd., toured the company’s green production lines, and inspected project implementations. Both sides held constructive talks on deepening China–Zimbabwe cooperation in new energy.

img.alt: Consuls General and Technical Delegations from Three South American Countries Visit TDG YUNET Energy Storage Factory to Discuss Green Energy Cooperation

a.p: Consuls General and Technical Delegations from Three South American Countries Visit TDG YUNET Energy Storage Factory to Discuss Green Energy Cooperation

On August 26, 2025, a delegation composed of Consuls General from Argentina, Chile, and Uruguay in Shanghai, along with technical representatives from their consulates and leaders from the Zhejiang Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai, visited TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. in Haining, Zhejiang, for an in-depth inspection and exchange at the company’s green energy industrial base.

img.alt: Showcasing the New Style of Intelligent Manufacturing | Mayor of Zaragoza, Spain Leads Delegation to Visit TDG YUNET Green Energy Factory

a.p: Showcasing the New Style of Intelligent Manufacturing | Mayor of Zaragoza, Spain Leads Delegation to Visit TDG YUNET Green Energy Factory

The year 2024 marked TDG YUNET’s efforts in overseas localization development, with multiple visits to the Aragon region and Zaragoza in Spain, bringing bilateral exchanges and cooperation to a new stage. On February 16, 2025, the Mayor of Zaragoza, Spain, Natalia Chueca, led a delegation to visit China and toured TDG YUNET’s green energy industrial factory. This visit further enhanced mutual understanding and trust, and opened new opportunities for future cooperation.

img.alt: Across Mountains and Seas, Planning the Future Together | TDG IBERNAVITAS Unveiling Ceremony Successfully Held

a.p: Across Mountains and Seas, Planning the Future Together | TDG IBERNAVITAS Unveiling Ceremony Successfully Held

On January 16, 2025, the unveiling ceremony of TDG IBERNAVITAS, invested and established by TDG YUNET, was successfully held at TDG headquarters in Haining, Jiaxing, Zhejiang. This ceremony marked an important step in TDG YUNET’s global strategic layout and further deepened its business expansion in the European market.

img.alt: Building a People-Centered City, Sharing a Better Life | TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. Attends 2024 World Cities Day China Main Event

a.p: Building a People-Centered City, Sharing a Better Life | TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. Attends 2024 World Cities Day China Main Event

Recently, the highly anticipated 2024 World Cities Day China Main Event was grandly held in Weihai, Shandong Province. The event, themed “Building a People-Centered City, Sharing a Better Life,” attracted hundreds of participants including government officials, experts, scholars, and business representatives from around the world. Gao Xuegong, Executive Director of TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd., and Xu Kaida, Deputy General Manager, were invited to attend the event.

img.alt: Leading the Future, Advancing China–Spain Science and Technology Cooperation | TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. Attends China–Spain Science and Technology Cooperation Event

a.p: Leading the Future, Advancing China–Spain Science and Technology Cooperation | TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. Attends China–Spain Science and Technology Cooperation Event

Zaragoza, Spain — September 25, 2024, TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. attended the “China–Spain Science and Technology Cooperation Theme Day” event held at the University of Zaragoza. Within this historic and academically vibrant institution, a grand gathering of scientific and technological elites from China and Spain was successfully held, marking a new step forward in bilateral cooperation in technological innovation.

img.alt: Empowering Green Development, Creating a Better Future Together | Grand Launch Ceremony of TDG Green Energy Industrial Base

a.p: Empowering Green Development, Creating a Better Future Together | Grand Launch Ceremony of TDG Green Energy Industrial Base

On the morning of September 13, under the joint witness of leaders from the Haining Economic and Technological Development Zone, Spanish guests, company executives, and representatives of resident enterprises, the inauguration ceremony of the TDG Green Energy Industrial Base, themed “Empowering Green Development, Creating a Better Future Together,” was grandly held at Phase II of the TDG Pan-Semiconductor Industrial Park.

img.alt: Exhibition Review | TDG YUNET Empowers Energy Innovation, Showcases at the 3rd ESSA Energy Storage Exhibition

a.p: Exhibition Review | TDG YUNET Empowers Energy Innovation, Showcases at the 3rd ESSA Energy Storage Exhibition

Recently, TDG YUNET Technology Co., Ltd. showcased its innovative technological products at the 3rd EESA Energy Storage Exhibition held at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), joining industry peers to explore a new chapter in energy development. The exhibition, themed “Green Carbon Ecology, Intelligent Energy Storage for a New Era,” comprehensively displayed energy storage system solutions, core equipment, advanced storage technologies, and applications, making it a major annual event in the energy storage industry.

img.alt: Government–Enterprise–University Collaboration to Jointly Draw a New Blueprint for New Energy Cooperation | TDG YUNET Explores Aragon and the University of Zaragoza in Depth

a.p: Government–Enterprise–University Collaboration to Jointly Draw a New Blueprint for New Energy Cooperation | TDG YUNET Explores Aragon and the University of Zaragoza in Depth

Recently, TDG YUNET’s European delegation carried out a significant exchange activity in the field of new energy in the Aragon region. During this visit, TDG YUNET not only conducted in-depth engagement with the University of Zaragoza and local new energy enterprises, but also held active exchanges and discussions with the Government of Aragon.
